title: CISA Adds Oracle WebLogic CVE-2024-21182 to KEV — Unauthenticated T3/IIOP Exploitation Confirmed

CVE-2024-21182.evidence: authenticated T3/IIOP Exploitation Confirmed CISA added CVE-2024-21182 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on June 1, confirming active exploitation of this Oracle WebLogic Server flaw.
